results.title: ECS Cluster Security Assessment
results.description: Security assessment results for the ECS Cluster component

findings.title: AC-2: Account Management - Implemented
findings.description: ECS cluster implements access control for user accounts and authentication through IAM roles and policies

assessment-methods.description: Code review of IAM role creation and policy attachment

findings.remarks: Access control is implemented through: (1) IAM roles for EC2 capacity instances (CapacityInstanceRole) with least-privilege managed policies (AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role, AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore), (2) Service Connect namespace access controls via VPC and security groups, (3) Auto Scaling Group IAM permissions scoped to ECS service operations. Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 211-226, 236-262.

findings.title: AC-3: Access Enforcement - Implemented
findings.description: ECS cluster implements access enforcement and authorization controls through IAM policies and resource-level permissions

assessment-methods.description: Review of IAM policy enforcement and access controls

findings.remarks: Access enforcement is implemented through: (1) ECS task execution roles with minimal required permissions, (2) Service Connect namespace permissions via VPC isolation and security groups, (3) CloudWatch logs access controls through IAM policies. Security groups restrict outbound traffic to HTTPS (port 443) for ECS control plane communication only. Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 204-209, 236-262.

findings.title: SC-7: Boundary Protection - Implemented
findings.description: ECS cluster implements network boundary protection and segmentation through VPC configuration, security groups, and private subnets

related-controls.control-title: Boundary Protection - Deny by Default / Allow by Exception

findings.remarks: Network boundary protection is implemented through: (1) VPC configuration for Service Connect namespace ensuring private network isolation, (2) Security group rules for ECS tasks restricting outbound traffic to HTTPS (port 443) only, with allowAllOutbound set to false, (3) Private subnet selection for EC2 capacity instances, (4) Network ACLs and routing tables managed by VPC configuration. Service Connect namespace provides network segmentation for microservices. Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 174-181, 197-209, 237-238.

findings.title: SC-13: Cryptographic Protection - Implemented
findings.description: ECS cluster implements cryptographic protection for data at rest and in transit using AWS KMS encryption

related-controls.control-title: Cryptographic Protection - Use of Approved Random Number Generators

findings.remarks: Cryptographic protection is implemented through: (1) ECS cluster encryption settings using AWS managed encryption, (2) Container image encryption via ECS service configuration, (3) Service Connect namespace encryption using VPC encryption, (4) EBS volume encryption for EC2 capacity instances using KMS keys (customer-managed or AWS-managed), (5) Encrypted block devices (GP3 volumes) with KMS key management. KMS keys are provisioned based on compliance framework requirements (highRiskEnvironment flag). Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 228-233, 252-260, 264-266, 844-903.

findings.title: SI-4: Information System Monitoring - Implemented
findings.description: ECS cluster implements comprehensive information system monitoring and detection capabilities through Container Insights, CloudWatch alarms, and observability dashboards

related-controls.control-title: Information System Monitoring - System-Wide Intrusion Detection System
Information System Monitoring - Automated Tools for Real-Time Analysis
Information System Monitoring - Inbound and Outbound Communications Traffic

findings.remarks: Information system monitoring is implemented through: (1) Container Insights configuration enabled for ECS cluster providing comprehensive metrics and logs, (2) CloudWatch alarms configured from observability/alarms-config.json with configurable thresholds and SNS notifications, (3) Service Connect monitoring via CloudWatch metrics and logs, (4) Observability dashboard with OpenTelemetry integration, (5) Log retention policies enforced for Container Insights log groups (performance and event) based on compliance framework requirements. Detailed CloudWatch monitoring enabled for EC2 instances when monitoring is enabled. Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 87-91, 249, 336-415, 418-444, 446-516, 518-545.

findings.title: SC-28: Protection of Information at Rest - Implemented (FedRAMP High)
findings.description: ECS cluster implements data protection and privacy controls through encryption, KMS key management, and data classification (FedRAMP High requirement)

related-controls.control-title: Protection of Information at Rest - Cryptographic Protection

findings.remarks: Data protection is implemented through: (1) Data classification and handling procedures via platform tagging standard with data-classification tags, (2) Encryption key management using AWS KMS with customer-managed keys provisioned for high-risk environments, (3) Data retention and disposal policies enforced through log retention settings and lifecycle policies. All EBS volumes are encrypted at rest using KMS keys. Implementation location: packages/components/ecs-cluster/src/ecs-cluster.component.ts lines 228-233, 252-260, 844-903.
